title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: the description is not in the PDF or CSV
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has open vendor documents, and you export A/P Unpaid Invoices to check the description is left out.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Search both files for the words "grouped by vendor".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the PDF downloads.
  • Step 2: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 3: the words are not found: the description is not in the PDF or CSV.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-N1: “The descriptions appear on screen only, not in the PDF or CSV.”
  • S8-R1: “Each report has the native report info icon (the one Work In Progress and Technician Utilization use) directly right of its title. Hovering, keyboard focus or a tap shows the report's description in a tooltip; moving away or Escape closes it. The descriptions:”
